entities.name: Gensai
entities.description: Thug with a shaved head and tattoos who mocked Jared Carthalion in Rifa's Inn.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Wayfarer who cast Hurricane in Rifa's Inn.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker Gensai claimed cast Jared as an illusion.

events.summary: Gensai mocked Jared Carthalion and called him an illusion cast by Ravidel; Jared cast Hurricane, tearing the inn apart.
events.quote: Gensai witnessed the wayfarer 's anger as he cast a Hurricane spell, tearing the inn apart
